title: duplicate resolve_secret_uri helper in transit and reader mains
description: resolve_secret_uri() is copy-pasted identically into crates/transit/src/main.rs and crates/reader/src/main.rs. The next daemon that needs secretx string resolution will copy it a third time. When the error-handling pattern changes (e.g. logging format, exit code), all copies need updating. Should live in a shared crate or module (stoa-tls, stoa-auth, or a new stoa-secrets helper crate) so there is one canonical site.
